struct Shape { output_rank: Option<usize>, tp: Vec<Vec<usize>> }
trait Plan { fn shape(world: usize) -> Vec<Vec<usize>>; }
type RankPlan = Vec<Vec<usize>>;
fn run(world: usize, rank: usize) -> Result<Vec<usize>> {
    let rows = split_rows(total, rank, world);
    let size = world * width;
    let halves = world >> 1;
    let rows = (0..world).map(|rank| rows[rank]).collect::<Vec<_>>();
    for rank in 0..world { send(rank, &rows); }
    if rows.is_empty() { return; }
    if tokens > capacity { reject(); }
    match dtype { Dtype::F32 => f32_rows(), Dtype::Bf16 => bf16_rows() }
    let note = "if world == 2 { alternate(); }";
    // if rank == 0 { alternate(); }
    /* match topology { Topology::Ring => alternate() } */
}
